scope: Shopee Indonesia Affiliate Open API product offer search and item lookup. Read-only. No shopper session, seller APIs, carts, purchases, link creation, account registration, or program writes.

market.priceSemantics: The official ProductOfferV2 schema describes price, priceMin, priceMax, and commission as decimal strings in local currency. The API schema does not return a currency code or a scale/unit example. Preserve decimal strings verbatim; do not divide, round, or label them as verified IDR.

transport.cookiePolicy: The durable client sends no cookies or user session. The official Explorer's in-page fetch sets credentials: include; server acceptance without cookies remains unverified because no live App ID/Secret was available.

authentication.scheme: Shopee Affiliate Open API SHA256 signature

signature.input: AppId + Timestamp + exact serialized JSON body + AppSecret

authentication.userLogin: No browser login flow is implemented. The request still requires a registered Shopee Affiliate App ID and App Secret.

priceFields.price: String; local-currency unit per Explorer schema
priceFields.priceMin: String; local-currency unit per Explorer schema
priceFields.priceMax: String; local-currency unit per Explorer schema
priceFields.commission: String; local-currency unit per Explorer schema
priceFields.precision: Preserved as server-provided decimal strings; no IEEE-754 conversion or scaling

commissionFields.appExistRate: String fraction for existing app users
commissionFields.appNewRate: String fraction for new app users
commissionFields.webExistRate: String fraction for existing web users
commissionFields.webNewRate: String fraction for new web users
commissionFields.rule: Return current item-specific API values. Do not hardcode a platform-wide commission range.

operations.name: getProductById
operations.identityRule: Every returned node itemId must match the requested itemId.

clientBoundary.credentials: App ID/Secret are held only in the caller's process memory and request Authorization header. They are excluded from the return value, receipt, and errors.

firstPartySources.title: Shopee Indonesia Affiliate Open API Explorer V2
facts: GraphQL endpoint is same Explorer origin /graphql

firstPartySources.title: Shopee Singapore Affiliate API Access
facts: Affiliate API supports Shopee, brand, and product offer lists; short links; conversion and validated reports

firstPartySources.title: Shopee Indonesia Affiliate Commission Scheme
facts: Commission scheme depends on channel/program conditions; this client reports live per-product API rate fields instead of declaring one universal rate

firstPartySources.title: Shopee Indonesia Affiliate Program enrollment
facts: Affiliate program signup is a separate account/program step and is not performed by this client

evidenceBoundary.anonymousStorefront: The public product URL led to Shopee's traffic verification/login-required screen. Its observed GET /api/v4/pdp/get_pc returned an error envelope without product data. This is recorded only as a blocker; it is not a Shopee Affiliate product API replacement.
evidenceBoundary.apiControl: A direct POST to the official /graphql endpoint with a read-only productOfferV2 query, no App ID, no signature, no cookies, and no user session returned HTTP 200 JSON GraphQL error code 10020 with no data. HTTP 200 is not a product success.
evidenceBoundary.affiliateApiClientStatus: Implemented and locally contract-tested; catalog business data remains unverified until valid App ID/Secret and API access are supplied.
